svg.title: Prefill, build by build
svg.desc: Milliseconds of prompt reading per 1,000 generated tokens, start on the left, the 56.02 config on the right. Each step is the difference between two measured builds (whole-run server-log splits, as in 2.1). Most builds carried several changes; the tables list them.
